title: Convert Integer values to String and String values to Integer
answer: To convert an `Integer` or `int` to a String, common choices are `Integer.toString(value)` and `String.valueOf(value)`. If the source is an `Integer` reference and may be null, `String.valueOf(integer)` returns the text `"null"`, while calling an instance method on a null reference would fail. To convert a numeric String to an integer value, use `Integer.parseInt(text)` when you need a primitive `int`, or `Integer.valueOf(text)` when you need an `Integer` object. Invalid numeric text causes `NumberFormatException`. In AeroTopo's `LanguageLab.numericConversions`, `Integer.toString(truncated)` creates numeric text and `Integer.parseInt(...)` converts that text back to an int.
